headline: Best call today — 2.5ft SE on a prime angle with a glassy morning.
today: This is the pick of the coast today. Prime SE swell to 2.6ft, some period on it, and the wind goes from 6mph cross-off at dawn to a near-dead 3mph light by mid-morning — glassy and rideable. Surf the morning before the S onshore sneaks in for the afternoon. Fish or a shortboard if you've got the punch, log works too. Worth the drive.

daysToWatch.note: Biggest day at 2.2-3ft on a prime S angle, but it's short-period and cross-on SSW all day — surfable and sizey, just won't be clean.
Solid 2.1-3ft prime SSE swell — cross-on at dawn tips to onshore, so get on it early.
